calculation.description: At each date, average the cross-sectional percentile ranks of 20-session raw return and 20-session return divided by trailing downside semideviation. The downside window requires at least five observations; values with zero downside risk are invalid. Higher values indicate stronger and more risk-adjusted momentum.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-day IC in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2025, and 2026; negative in 2024. Small cross-asset universe and roughly 10.6 valid instruments per date require conservative interpretation.

provenance.signal_artifact: reproducible from listed script and persistent stock_data
